title: Repair daily time-range overlap
instructions:
Fix two logic bugs in `time_ranges.py`: overnight splitting and endpoint counting.
Keep the existing public functions and signatures:
- `parse_time(text: str) -> int`: minutes since midnight.
- `overlap_minutes(start_a: str, end_a: str, start_b: str, end_b: str) -> int`.
- `overlaps(start_a, end_a, start_b, end_b) -> bool` and
  `disjoint(start_a, end_a, start_b, end_b) -> bool`, its logical opposite.
All four time arguments are guaranteed valid zero-padded `HH:MM` strings from `00:00` to
`23:59`; malformed input is outside scope. Ranges are half-open: start included, end excluded.
Touching endpoints do not overlap. Equal start and end means an empty range.
When end is earlier than start, the range crosses midnight. Treat all ranges as portions of
the same repeating 24-hour day, with no dates or timezones. For example, `23:00`–`02:00`
and `01:00`–`03:00` overlap for 60 minutes. Two overnight ranges can overlap in both their
late-evening and early-morning pieces; sum the pieces exactly once.

## Files
- `time_ranges.py`
